name: Hide2Less
tagline: 在手机上将受支持的 RootHide 插件和 App 包转换为 Rootless 安装包。
notice: 并非所有安装包都能转换，转换成功也不代表运行兼容。结果可能依赖 Hide2Less compat，可一起分发，或添加并刷新 Banana 源下载依赖。
description: 独立的手机端转换工具。选择 DEB 后生成新的 Rootless 安装包，保留原始文件。
通过系统分享将结果交给用户选择的包管理器，或保存到文件；不会自动安装软件。
features: 工具提供 Rootless、RootHide 两种安装包，转换结果统一为 Rootless
支持受支持的插件包、App 包及混合包转换
兼容转换与直接转换两种模式
按需导出已内置的 compat 兼容包，可随转换结果分发或从 Banana 源获取
文件导入、转换进度与日志、系统分享
主界面右上角显示版本号，与关于页同步
简体中文、繁体中文、英文及社区入口
安装更新后自动关闭旧版应用，重新打开加载新版
compatibility: 最低 iOS 15；按当前越狱环境安装对应的 Rootless 或 RootHide 工具包
工具需要 dpkg >= 1.21.18、ldid、shell-cmds；转换结果按需依赖 compat，App 转换结果还依赖系统应用注册组件
不会扩展原安装包的系统或硬件支持范围；仅有 arm64e 的程序仍要求相应设备支持
转换结果仍需在目标越狱环境验证运行。
usage: 安装与你的越狱环境对应的工具包。安装更新完成后重新打开 Hide2Less，选择 .deb 文件。
选择兼容转换或直接转换；完成后从系统分享窗口保存结果，或交给包管理器。
若提示依赖 compat，使用“分享兼容包”与转换包一起分发；接收者先安装 compat，再安装转换包。也可添加并刷新 https://iyaway.github.io/ 自动下载依赖。
两种环境均通过系统分享导出或保存结果。遇到不支持的安装包时，按提示交由开发者适配。

changes: 新增受支持的 App 包转换，提升插件包转换兼容性。
改进转换结果保存与失败提示。
主界面右上角显示版本号，与关于页保持一致。
修复 RootHide 下 iCloud 导入失败及选包后的转换按钮状态。
扩展常见安装包的读取与转换支持，改进不支持情形的提示。
安装更新后自动关闭旧版应用，再次打开即可使用新版本。
修复 RootHide 环境下从 iCloud 导入安装包失败的问题。
提升部分插件安装包的读取与转换兼容性。
修复选包后的转换按钮状态，并改进失败提示。
支持在手机上将受支持的 RootHide 插件包转换为 Rootless 安装包。
提供兼容转换、直接转换与系统分享，保留原始文件。
提供简体中文、繁体中文、英文，以及兼容包获取与分发说明。

en.name: Hide2Less
en.tagline: Convert supported RootHide tweak and app packages to Rootless packages on device.
en.notice: Not every package can be converted, and successful conversion does not prove runtime compatibility. Results may require Hide2Less compat; distribute it with the converted package, or add and refresh the Banana repository to obtain it.
description: An independent on-device converter. Choose a DEB to create a new Rootless package while preserving the original file.
Use system sharing to send results to a package manager of your choice or save them to Files. Software is never installed automatically.
features: Rootless and RootHide tool packages; converted packages always target Rootless
Convert supported tweak, app and mixed packages
Export the bundled compat package when needed, distribute it with converted packages, or obtain it from the Banana repository
File import, progress and logs, and system sharing
Show the version at the top right of the home screen, consistent with About
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and community links
Close the old app after installation or upgrade; reopen to load the new version
compatibility: Requires iOS 15 or later; install the tool package for your Rootless or RootHide environment
Requires dpkg >= 1.21.18, ldid and shell-cmds; converted packages use compat when needed, while app conversions also require the system application registration component
Does not expand the original package's system or hardware support; arm64e-only programs still require compatible hardware
Converted packages require runtime verification in their target jailbreak environment.
usage: Install the tool package for your jailbreak environment. Reopen Hide2Less after installation or upgrade, then select a .deb file.
Choose compatibility or direct mode. When conversion finishes, save the result or send it to a package manager using system sharing.

If compat is required, use Share compatibility package to distribute it with the converted package. Recipients install compat first, then the converted package. Alternatively, add and refresh https://iyaway.github.io/ for automatic dependency downloads.
Both environments export or save results through system sharing. Unsupported packages require developer adaptation.

changes: Add conversion for supported app packages and improve tweak package compatibility.
Improve saving conversion results and failure messages.
Show the version at the top right of the home screen and keep it consistent with About.
Fix failed iCloud imports on RootHide and the conversion button state after package selection.
Expand reading and conversion support for common packages and improve unsupported-package messages.
Close the previous app instance after installation or upgrade so reopening loads the new version.
Fix failed iCloud package imports on RootHide.
Improve reading and conversion compatibility for additional tweak packages.
Fix the conversion button state after selecting a package and improve failure messages.
Convert supported RootHide tweak packages to Rootless packages on device.
Includes compatibility and direct modes, system sharing, and preservation of the original file.
Includes Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and guidance for obtaining and distributing the compatibility package.
